input: Track every purchase in cash for two weeks

gold.taskTitle: Track every cash purchase for two weeks
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to monitor and record all cash spending over a two-week period.

questions.title: What is your main reason for tracking cash purchases?
questions.description: Understanding the goal — budgeting, reducing spending, auditing — shapes how the tracking system should be set up.

questions.title: Which specific two weeks are you starting this?
questions.description: Knowing the exact start date helps schedule reminders and define the tracking window precisely.

questions.title: What tool do you want to use for recording?
questions.description: The user may prefer a phone app, a notes app, a spreadsheet, a physical notebook, or something else entirely.

questions.title: Do you want to categorize purchases or just list them?
questions.description: Knowing whether categories like food, transport, or entertainment are needed determines the structure of the log.

questions.title: How much cash do you typically spend in a day?
questions.description: An estimate of daily cash volume helps gauge the effort required and whether a budget threshold matters.

questions.title: Will you log purchases in the moment or at end of day?
questions.description: The logging frequency affects what reminder system or habit trigger needs to be built into the plan.

questions.title: What do you plan to do with the data afterward?
questions.description: Whether the user wants a summary report, a spending insight, or to share it with someone shapes the end format.
